metal Detector:
the metal detector is very useful in detecting traps or metal objects buried in the ground.

Defusable mine:
set it down and move away. it will go off by itself after 5 seconds. 
put it in a spot you want to protect...

the first sheep I see move
goes back in the flock!!!

                  Sam.

It is recommended you have a
sheep before entering this cave.

   an admiring spectator.

Sheep Costume:
the sheep costume lets you disguise yourself as a sheep!

to talk to a sheep:

press once on the $B_ACTION$ button, if a sheep answers, it means he will follow you.

if you press again on the $B_ACTION$ button and the sheep answers a second time, he will stop where he is.
